name: straddle_tight_1000_NQ_tf30_nyam_evC
idea: tight bracket at 10:00 ET, 10:00 release days
rule: One second before 10:00 ET: a buy stop 3 points above the price and a sell stop 3 points below (one cancels the other; unfilled orders are cancelled after 5 minutes). One trade a day. Stop 5 points; target 3 x the stop. Session: New York morning (09:30-11:00 ET); flat by 15:58 ET. Traded ONLY on days with a 10:00 ET release (ISM manufacturing, ISM services, JOLTS, Michigan sentiment prelim).
rationale: The first seconds after a scheduled time are one-way; a tight bracket catches the burst with a small stop (10:00 ET).
flags: BURST FILL RISK: a two-sided bracket over a data release; the simulator fills the stop on the trigger print (out/events_summary.md section 5: with a fill 1-25 ms later most of the profit of the v1 defaults went)
thin control (random-minute store: 2 seeds on disk)
FAST: more than 50 % of the average variant's profit is from trades held under 5 s (Lucid account-level limit)
default_rule: survivors sorted by (BUILD net, variant order); the middle one; an even count takes the lower of the two middle ones
admission: v2 (EDGE_SPEC ADMISSION v2: the average of all variants)
